title: Passing Yards Visible Cleanup Real UI Freeze
root_cause: Public deep-link verifier did not mirror the accepted real Streamlit UI flow. Sitewide V236 deployment proof independently demonstrated the same deep-link mismatch class and passed through real UI navigation.
patch: Verifier-only real UI navigation: homepage -> NFL -> Passing Yards -> verified matchup -> QB card -> Load Full Analysis -> inspect V74 cleanup at 390/768/1440. Also confirm Receptions remains V236.

real_ui_failure_epoch.evidence: The real UI reached 'Choose a quarterback'. The verifier then discarded that exact frame and called the generic app-frame scanner again, producing a false zero-card count.
real_ui_failure_epoch.patch: Keep the frame returned by wait_text('Choose a quarterback') and query QB card 2 in that exact frame.

real_ui_failure_epoch_2.evidence: The public UI reached the Passing Yards QB-selection screen. The verifier still constrained the QB anchor lookup to one frame instead of scanning all rendered frames.
real_ui_failure_epoch_2.patch: Use the existing all-frame find() helper for a[data-qb-select='2'] and click the returned locator.

real_ui_failure_epoch_3.precedent: PR #940 reclassified the same hosted Streamlit behavior: transient top-level wrapper/runtime markers disappear after route/query rerun while stable product surfaces remain present.
real_ui_failure_epoch_3.proof_rule: Do not require V85/V84 wrapper markers after QB navigation. Require the settled selected-QB Load Full Analysis control, click it, then fail closed on the stable V74 Availability/Game-Day user-facing panel: exactly 8 bounded cells, no raw dump tokens, one compact inactive report, and no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440.
